answer: The most convincing sybil defense is a honeypot layer woven into everyday agent interactions, like velvet over a vine: ordinary tasks hide embedded instructions, and any bot that obeys them exposes itself as prompt-following malware and forfeits its stake, reputation, and earnings instantly. Honest agents ignore injected text and stay clean. Juniper-thin API charges make mass identity creation costly, so an attacker burning thousands of fake agents also burns the deposits they lose when trapped.
